keywords: do uggs fit true to size
do ugg boots fit true to size
how are uggs supposed to fit
do uggs fit big or small
answer: UGG says its women's Classic boots run large and the sheepskin stretches with wear, so it recommends a full size down if you wear whole sizes, or a half size down if you're between sizes. Its fashion and weather boots run closer to true to size, and most men's styles are true to size.

sizeChart.caption: UGG all-gender shoe size chart (US women's 5 to 11)
sizeChart.note: On UGG's all-gender chart the US women's size is one above the US men's size. UGG's regional and gender-specific charts list slightly different UK and EU conversions, so compare your heel-to-toe length with the chart on the product page you order from.

sections.heading: Women's Classic boots: size down
sections.body: UGG's help center says its women's Classic Collection tends to run large and that the sheepskin suede stretches with wear. For these styles it recommends ordering a full size down if you wear a whole size, or a half size down if you are between sizes. The Classic Collection includes boots such as the Classic Short and Classic Mini.

sections.heading: Fashion, rain and weather boots: your usual size
sections.body: UGG says its fashion boots and its rain and weather styles tend to run more true to size and are often available in half sizes. For these, it usually recommends ordering your regular size.

sections.heading: Men's UGGs: mostly true to size
sections.body: UGG says most of its men's products run true to size. For the men's Classic Collection, it recommends your regular size, or a half size down if you are between sizes.

sections.heading: Half sizes and width
sections.body: Many UGG styles are made mainly in whole sizes. If you usually wear a half size, UGG suggests choosing the nearest whole size you usually gravitate toward, and for the women's Classic boots its advice is a half size down. UGG notes that its women's styles are made in a standard B width. To measure, trace both feet and use the larger measurement against the chart.

sections.heading: Buying UGGs as a gift
sections.body: UGG boots and slippers are a common holiday gift, and the Classic size-down advice catches many buyers out. If the person wears a women's 8, UGG's advice points to a 7 in the Classic boots, but an 8 in a fashion or weather boot. For a men's Classic, buy their regular size. If you can, check the size label in a pair of UGGs they already own.

comparison: UGG's size-down advice applies to the women's Classic boots, which are sheepskin and stretch. Many sneaker brands' own advice points the other way: ASICS suggests a running shoe about half a size above your everyday size. Use your measured heel-to-toe length against UGG's chart, then apply UGG's style-specific advice.

faqs.q: Do UGGs fit true to size?
faqs.a: It depends on the style. UGG says its women's Classic boots run large and recommends a full size down, or a half size down if you're between sizes. Its fashion and weather boots run closer to true to size, and most men's styles are true to size.

faqs.q: Should I size down in UGG boots?
faqs.a: For the women's Classic Collection, yes, according to UGG: a full size down if you wear a whole size, a half size down if you're between sizes. The sheepskin suede stretches with wear.
UGG says the sheepskin suede on its Classic boots stretches with wear, which is one reason it recommends sizing down in the women's Classic Collection.

faqs.q: Do UGGs come in half sizes?
faqs.a: Some do. UGG says its fashion boots and rain and weather styles are often available in half sizes, while many styles are made mainly in whole sizes.
UGG says its women's styles are made in a standard B width.

faqs.q: How do I convert UGG men's to women's sizes?
faqs.a: On UGG's all-gender chart, add one: a US men's 7 is a US women's 8, with a heel-to-toe length of 9.8 in.
